## Checklist
- [ ] Works with `npm run dev`; typecheck and lint pass
- [ ] Stays inside my role's folders, or the other person has approved the shared change (`src/model/`)
- [ ] Any new dependency, model, font or sound is added to `CREDITS.md` with a verified license
- [ ] Media still never leaves the device; any external call is opt-in and labelled
- [ ] User edits stay locked (AI does not override them)
- [ ] `STATUS.md` updated
